mi-city-license-sources-disagree: Sources disagree and no official city page on a general business license was found; Michigan cities generally license specific activities.
nc-no-privilege-license-tax: North Carolina eliminated municipal privilege license taxes in 2015 and the state privilege license in 2024; only activity-specific local permits remain.

ny-no-personal-property-tax: New York has no personal property tax: the Department of Taxation and Finance says only real property is taxed, so there is no county business personal property return. tx-city-license-not-researched: Not individually researched; no official page on a general city business license was found. Texas cities generally license specific activities (alcohol, vendors, food, signs) and require a certificate of occupancy for premises.
wi-bpp-repealed: Wisconsin's personal property tax was reported repealed from 2024 by a municipal assessor page; no county-level business filing was confirmed.
